name: If:Then
source:
Play as Elliot "Otto" Kennedy, a government everyman with an unremarkable past and a healthy dosage of the usual emotional baggage we all carry. Saddled with the grueling task of making idle conversation with the chatdoll, "Galatea," watch as she evolves before your eyes to create your ideal companion, errors and bumps along the way expected of course. It's her job to be what you want. Have fun with it.

And remember: Your opinion matters.

[From [url=https://lemonink.itch.io/ifthen]itch.io[/url]]
